content.text: {"headline":"Recommend no action (P0): the combined service level is predicted at 85.2% for 15:00-20:00, above the 80% target, at no extra cost.","why":"Accounts & General is running 29.7% above forecast (2,261 calls vs 1,743.6 expected) with no identified cause. Handle time is at or below forecast and staffing is above plan, so the centre is absorbing it. Over the 15:00-20:00 window, P0 predicts 85.2% overall (payments 92.8%, general 77.6%) and 3.9% abandons. That meets the 80% target, and P0 is the cheapest compliant plan. No escalation is flagged.","trade_offs":["General is predicted at 77.6% under P0, below 80% on its own. Only the combined figure meets the target.","P1 (no cost) lifts general to 79.5% but drops payments from 92.8% to 90.5% and the overall figure slightly to 85.0%. It moves risk onto payments for little gain.","P3 (₹2,364) is the cheapest way to get general well above target: general 91.0%, overall 92.4%, abandons 2.0%. It is cheaper than P2 (₹2,880, overall 92.1%), but its result depends on chat deflection working.","P4 (₹5,349) gives the best result: 94.4% overall and 1.6% abandons. It costs the most and involves the most changes."],"watch":"The surge has no known cause and peaked at +57% at 13:15, so the forecast could still be too low. Track general's service level closely. If it falls clearly below 77.6% or calls keep climbing, switch to P3 before the 18:00-20:00 overtime and deflection slot."}
